analysis.headline: USD/KRW dips to 1,342.7 after BOK hikes to 3.25%; NDF at 1,342.4
analysis.summary: USD/KRW fell 0.5 KRW to 1,342.7 in Seoul (ECB 1,344.6) after the BOK hiked 25 bps to 3.25% (5–2) and lifted 2026–27 GDP forecasts to 3.9% and 4.1%. KOSPI edged up 0.29% to 4,711.21, while 1M NDF traded near 1,342.4 in holiday lull.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW rises to 1,475.8 as hawkish ECB minutes lift euro toward 1.098
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW rebounded to 1,475.8 (ECB ref 1,475.75). With US Thanksgiving keeping the dollar in a breather near DXY 103.8, ECB October minutes showing support for keeping tight policy lifted EUR/USD back toward 1.097–1.098.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW edges down to 844.3 per 100 JPY as yen stays flat near 159.3
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW slipped slightly to 844.3 per 100 JPY (ECB ref 8.443). BoJ board member Tamura urged faster hikes, yet holiday-thin trading and US-Japan rate gaps kept USD/JPY pinned near 159.3 below the 160 intervention watch.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW climbs to 1,762.0 as sterling regains 1.310 during Thanksgiving lull
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW rose to 1,762.0 (ECB ref 1,761.98). Markets digested the BoE Financial Stability Report while thin US Thanksgiving liquidity eased greenback pressure, allowing GBP/USD to reclaim the 1.310 handle.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW rebounds to 201.9 as firm offshore yuan near 6.66 offsets tariff risk
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW climbed to around 201.9 (ECB ref 201.89). Although the PBOC nudged the USD/CNY midpoint slightly softer to 6.7096 and US tariff proposals targeting 14 partners lingered, offshore yuan (CNH) held firm near 6.661, lifting the cross.

AUD.headline: AUD rebounds to 892.2 KRW as hot 4.9% CPI and USD lull lift pair to 0.663
AUD.brief: Aussie climbed to 892.2 KRW as 4.9% CPI curbed RBA rate-cut bets and Thanksgiving USD consolidation lifted AUD/USD toward 0.663.

CAD.headline: CAD rises to 945.0 KRW as WTI crude tops $83 alongside hawkish BoC stance
CAD.brief: Loonie rose to 945.0 KRW as WTI crude climbed past $83/bbl and hawkish BoC tone nudged USD/CAD down toward 1.422.

CHF.headline: CHF slips to 1,612.3 KRW as holiday calm eases safe-haven tech flows
CHF.brief: Swiss franc eased to 1,612.3 KRW as Thanksgiving calm quieted tech swings and lifted EUR/CHF to 0.915 alongside firmer KRW.

CNY.headline: CNY rises to 201.9 KRW as firm CNH near 6.66 outweighs softer 6.7096 fix
CNY.brief: Yuan climbed to 201.9 KRW as offshore CNH strength near 6.661 outweighed a 6.7096 PBOC fix and US tariff jitters.

EUR.headline: EUR rebounds to 1,475.8 KRW as hawkish ECB minutes lift euro to 1.098
EUR.brief: Euro rose to 1,475.8 KRW as ECB October minutes backed tight policy during the Thanksgiving USD lull, lifting EUR/USD toward 1.098.

GBP.headline: GBP climbs to 1,762.0 KRW as sterling reclaims 1.310 in holiday lull
GBP.brief: Sterling climbed to 1,762.0 KRW after digesting the BoE stability report as thin US holiday trade helped GBP/USD retake 1.310.

HKD.headline: HKD eases slightly to 171.6 KRW tracking Seoul USD/KRW dip near 7.837 peg
HKD.brief: Anchored near 7.837 inside its USD peg band, HKD edged slightly lower to 171.6 KRW alongside Seoul USD/KRW slipping 0.5 KRW to 1,342.7.

JPY.headline: JPY edges down to 844.3 KRW per 100 JPY as yen holds flat near 159.3
JPY.brief: USD/JPY stayed pinned near 159.3 despite BoJ Tamura's hawkish remarks amid holiday thinness and 160 watch, nudging JPY/KRW to 844.3.

KRW.headline: KRW firms to 1,342.7 after BOK hikes to 3.25% & lifts GDP outlook; NDF 1,342.4
KRW.brief: Won gained 0.5 KRW to 1,342.7 as BOK hiked 25 bps to 3.25% (5–2) and lifted 2026–27 GDP forecasts to 3.9% and 4.1%; NDF 1,342.4.

USD.headline: DXY takes a breather at 103.8 over US Thanksgiving; Seoul closes at 1,342.7
USD.brief: With US markets shut for Thanksgiving, DXY paused near 103.8 despite Dec Fed hike bets while Seoul closed down at 1,342.7 after BOK hike.
